reviewed_by: Claude general-purpose subagent, blind judgment reviewer, batch 2

competency_fulfillment.rationale: regrouping is this node's newly introduced vocabulary word and the competency's central point ('with or without regrouping'), yet all five samples report difficulty_axes_served.regrouping as 'none' and the sums observed (13, 25, 44, 24, 46) are all comfortably under 100, let alone the 1000 ceiling the competency states.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: addition registers 4 axes with 8 combos; if regrouping is one binary axis among four, roughly half of the 8 combos should require regrouping, so 5-for-5 samples landing on 'none' is a fairly low-probability draw worth flagging even though validate_matrix separately checks exhaustive combo execution.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Stems such as '12 + 12 = ___' are minimal-length cloze/mcq items well under the 18-word cap, appropriate for grade 2 quarter 1 reading level.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: The registered 8-combo addition space should in principle support both regrouping and non-regrouping items up to 1000, but none of that variety is evidenced in this sample, so mastery of the 'with regrouping' half of the competency is not demonstrated here.

competency_alignment.rationale: Because the introduced vocabulary word for this node is literally 'regrouping', a healthy sample set should show at least one item exercising it; seeing zero regrouping cases across 5 draws makes it hard to confirm this node teaches the skill it is named for.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Sums observed max at 46 while the competency states sums up to 1000; even accounting for early-node ramp-up, this leaves the top of the range untested in this sample and is worth monitoring against exhaustive matrix runs.
